## Context
On the Gerrit `Verified` gate, `tests/unit/test_opcert_service_app.py::test_matching_guard_is_accepted`
intermittently crashes its pytest-xdist worker (`worker gwN crashed`; `[gwN] node down: Not properly
terminated`), failing the whole matrix job and producing a spurious `Verified -1`. The failure is a hard
worker-process death (not an assertion), lands on a RANDOM matrix job per run (~1 of 4), and is
timing/platform-dependent. Observed 4+ consecutive times on 2026-08-08 blocking change 1545 (ticket ad16),
whose diff is markdown/comment-only and cannot touch `opcert_service`. Reproduction is CI-only.

## Root-cause hypothesis
The opcert app lifespan cancels and awaits its worker tasks correctly, so the crash most likely originates in
the test's `TestClient` lifespan / anyio portal teardown (or an `asyncio.to_thread` interaction) under xdist
load — the `with TestClient(app_module.app) as c` fixture enters/exits the ASGI lifespan on the worker, and an
unawaited background task or portal thread outliving the block can hard-kill the worker.

## Plan
Harden the test-side teardown so no background task/portal thread can outlive the `TestClient` context, and (if
the app is implicated) make the app lifespan teardown deterministically join its worker tasks:
- In `tests/unit/test_opcert_service_app.py`: make the `TestClient` fixture teardown deterministic — enter/exit
  the client via an explicit context whose exit is guaranteed, ensuring the ASGI lifespan shutdown (and any
  spawned worker task) is fully awaited before the worker moves on. If a residual race remains, serialize this
  module onto a single xdist worker with a `@pytest.mark.xdist_group` marker so a teardown race can no longer
  fell an unrelated matrix shard.
- In `src/rebar/opcert_service/app.py` (only if the repro implicates it): ensure the lifespan shutdown path
  awaits/cancels every spawned task with a bounded join so no task is left running past shutdown.

Scope is limited to the two files in file_impact; no production request/response behavior changes.

## Testing
- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/test_opcert_service_app.py -p xdist -n 4 --count 20 -q` runs the
  module under xdist repeatedly and must show 0 worker crashes (`grep -c "node down" <log>` returns `0`).
- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/test_opcert_service_app.py -q` passes with the hardened fixture.
- Durable confirmation on CI: the `Verified` matrix goes green on this change and stays green across at least
  3 consecutive re-runs (`recheck`) with no `worker gwN crashed` line in any job log.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The `TestClient` fixture teardown in `tests/unit/test_opcert_service_app.py` is deterministic: the ASGI
      lifespan shutdown and every spawned task/portal thread are fully awaited/joined before the context exits
      (verified: the fixture exits via a guaranteed context-manager exit, not a bare instantiation).
- [ ] Under repeated xdist load the worker no longer dies:
      `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/test_opcert_service_app.py -p xdist -n 4 --count 20 -q 2>&1 | grep -c "node down"`
      returns `0`.
- [ ] `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/test_opcert_service_app.py -q` passes.
- [ ] If the app lifespan is implicated by the repro, `src/rebar/opcert_service/app.py` shutdown joins/cancels
      all spawned worker tasks with a bounded wait; otherwise `app.py` is left unchanged and this is noted in the
      close comment.
- [ ] The `Verified` CI matrix is green on this change and stays green across at least 3 consecutive re-runs with
      no `worker gwN crashed` / `node down` line in any job log.
